meta.name: eventbridge
meta.description: AWS EventBridge serverless event bus for event-driven architectures. Use when creating rules, configuring event patterns, setting up scheduled events, integrating with SaaS, or building cross-account event routing.

copy.tagline: 配置事件规则，驱动无服务器架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 AWS 构建事件驱动系统
copy.tagline_en: Configure event rules to drive serverless architectures
copy.fit_line_en: For you if building event-driven systems on AWS

howto.what: Claude 可以帮你创建和管理 AWS EventBridge 事件总线、规则、目标，以及发布事件和设置定时调度。
howto.when: 当你需要配置事件驱动架构、创建规则、设置定时事件或集成 SaaS 时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个自定义事件总线，并添加一条规则。
say.note: Claude 会生成创建事件总线和规则的命令。

say.text: 设置一个每5分钟触发一次的定时事件。
发布一条订单创建事件到 my-app-events 总线。
say.note: Claude 会生成 put_events 的代码。

howto.what_en: Claude can help you create and manage AWS EventBridge event buses, rules, targets, publish events, and set up scheduled events.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to configure event-driven architectures, create rules, set up scheduled events, or integrate with SaaS.

say_en.text: Create a custom event bus and add a rule.
say_en.note: Claude will generate commands to create the bus and rule.

say_en.text: Set up a scheduled event that runs every 5 minutes.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a rate(5 minutes) schedule.

say_en.text: Publish an order created event to my-app-events bus.
